name: PT Perdana Gapuraprima Tbk
summary: PT Perdana Gapuraprima Tbk engages in the development of real estate properties in Indonesia. The company operates through Residence and Kavling; and Apartment, Office, and Shopping Center segments. It develops shopping centers, offices, apartments, hotels, condotels, houses, and mixed used projects. The company also engages in leasing of commercial properties; and contracting, executing, planning, and supervising construction of houses and buildings, as well as real estate development activities; and buying and selling of buildings and land rights. PT Perdana Gapuraprima Tbk was founded in 1987 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
